associations.rationale: This proves uniqueness of an index in the family Pfam for each indecomposable projective, which is a classification component but does not state the projective-cover maps requested by the packet.
This classifies an indecomposable projective as Pplus or Pminus, but it does not also establish either required projective-cover map.
This establishes projectivity, surjectivity, and the kernel condition for the Pminus map, so it supplies one projective-cover component rather than the full classification-and-maps claim.
This establishes projectivity, surjectivity, and the kernel condition for the Pplus map, so it supplies one projective-cover component rather than the full classification-and-maps claim.
